declarations.name: ColorSyncProfile.HeadroomAdaptiveGainCurve
declarations.comment:
Headroom Adaptive Gain Curve metadata that describes how to tone map a
profile's HDR content to the dynamic range available on the display.

A profile stores this metadata in its HAGC tag; it applies only to
profiles whose transfer function is PQ, HLG, or linear. Use
``colorVolumeTransform`` to describe the tone mapping to perform, then
embed the curve in a profile with
`ColorSyncProfileCreateCopyWithHeadroomAdaptiveGainCurveInfoDictionary`.

members.name: init
members.comment:
Creates Headroom Adaptive Gain Curve metadata.

- Parameters:
  - applicationVersion: The ST 2094-50 application version. Must be `0`.
  - colorVolumeTransform: The color volume transform to apply, or `nil`
    for none.
- Throws: ``Error/unsupportedApplicationVersion(_:)`` if
  `applicationVersion` is not `0`.

members.name: applicationVersion
members.comment:
The application version of the metadata, as defined by ST 2094-50.

This 3-bit field is currently always `0`. Initializing the metadata
with any other value throws ``Error/unsupportedApplicationVersion(_:)``.

declarations.comment:
A color volume transform that maps HDR content into a display's
dynamic range.

A color volume transform can override the standard HDR reference white
and, optionally, supply headroom-adaptive tone mapping.

Creates a color volume transform.

- Parameters:
  - customHDRReferenceWhite: A custom HDR reference white luminance
    in nits, or `nil` to use the standard 203-nit reference white.
    Must be greater than `0` when specified.
  - adaptiveToneMapping: The headroom-adaptive tone mapping to apply,
    or `nil` for none.
- Throws: ``Error/invalidHDRReferenceWhite(_:)`` if

declarations.name: ColorSyncProfile.HeadroomAdaptiveGainCurve.ColorVolumeTransform.ToneMapping
declarations.comment:
Headroom-adaptive tone mapping that adjusts HDR content to the
display's available headroom.

A tone mapping pairs a baseline headroom with a ``Method`` that
describes how to map content above reference white.

members.name: init
members.comment:
Creates a headroom-adaptive tone mapping.

- Parameters:
  - baselineHeadroomStops: The headroom of the source content in
    stops above reference white. Must be greater than or equal to `0`.
  - method: The tone-mapping method to apply. Defaults to
    ``Method/referenceWhiteBased``.
- Throws: ``Error/negativeBaselineHeadroom(_:)`` if
  `baselineHeadroomStops` is negative.

declarations.name: ColorSyncProfile.HeadroomAdaptiveGainCurve.ColorVolumeTransform.ToneMapping.Method.AdaptiveGainCurve
declarations.comment:
A set of headroom-adaptive gain curves and the chromaticities
used to drive them.

Each ``AlternateCurve`` targets a different display headroom;
the renderer selects the curve closest to the display's actual
headroom.

members.name: init
members.comment:
Creates an adaptive gain curve.

- Parameters:
  - chromaticities: The chromaticities used to derive the
    driving signal. Defaults to ``Chromaticities/bt709``.
  - alternateCurves: The alternate curves. At most four.
- Throws: ``Error/tooManyAlternateCurves(count:limit:)`` if
  more than four curves are supplied, or
  ``Error/invalidCustomChromaticities`` if custom
  chromaticities fall outside the valid range.

declarations.comment: The spline control points that define a gain curve.

members.name: init
members.comment:
Creates a set of spline control points.

- Parameters:
  - x: Input levels normalized by reference white: 1.0 = reference white,
    and at most 32 points.
  - y: Gain offsets in stops, one per `x` value. Must have
    the same count as `x` and non-negative.
  - slopes: How the framework determines the slope at each
    control point. Defaults to ``Slopes/interpolate``.
- Throws: ``Error/mismatchedControlPointArrays(x:y:)`` if
  `x` and `y` differ in count,
  ``Error/tooManyControlPoints(count:limit:)`` if there are
  more than 32 points, or
  ``Error/mismatchedTangentCount(got:expected:)`` if
  explicit `slopes` don't match the point count.

globals.name: headroomAdaptiveGainCurve
globals.comment:
The Headroom Adaptive Gain Curve embedded in this profile, or `nil` if it
carries no HAGC tag.

This decodes the HAGC tag into its structured form. For the unparsed
bytes, use ``headroomAdaptiveGainCurveMetadata``.

globals.name: headroomAdaptiveGainCurveMetadata
globals.comment:
The raw Headroom Adaptive Gain Curve data embedded in this profile, or
`nil` if it carries no HAGC tag.

This is equivalent to the serialized SMPTE ST 2094-50. Embed it in another profile
with ``adding(headroomAdaptiveGainCurveMetadata:options:)``, or read the
decoded form from ``headroomAdaptiveGainCurve``.

globals.name: adding
globals.comment:
Returns a copy of this profile with raw Headroom Adaptive Gain Curve data
embedded as an HAGC tag.

The curve is validated when you construct ``HeadroomAdaptiveGainCurve``, so
this method only embeds it. The original profile is unchanged.

- Parameter headroomAdaptiveGainCurve: The HAGC info dictionary to create the metadata embedded in the profile.
- Returns: A new profile carrying the HAGC tag, or `nil` if this profile's
  transfer function isn't PQ, HLG, or linear, or if embedding fails.

globals.name: adding
globals.comment:
Returns a copy of this profile with raw Headroom Adaptive Gain Curve data
embedded as an HAGC tag.

Use this to move an HAGC between profiles without interpreting it — for
example, to carry the HAGC payload read from one profile into
another, or one shared with a video stream (SMPTE ST 2094-50 payload).
The original profile is unchanged.

- Parameters:
  - headroomAdaptiveGainCurveMetadata: The raw HAGC payload to embed.
  - options: Options that configure embedding. Reserved for future use.
- Returns: A new profile carrying the HAGC tag, or `nil` if this profile's
  transfer function isn't PQ, HLG, or linear, or if embedding fails.
